Goo DevTools CLI 0.5.4

Usage:
  goo dev [options] -- <command> [args]
  goo attach [options]
  goo doctor [--json]
  goo capture [options]
  goo input <event> [--pid PID --window NAME] [--node ID | --x X --y Y] [options]

Commands:
  dev       Start a Goo project with diagnostics enabled and dotnet watch by default.
  attach    Attach to a live Goo endpoint and stream protocol events.
  doctor    Check the SDK, project, endpoint directory, and inspector installation.
  capture   Request a screenshot from an attached endpoint.
  input     Send an opted-in pointer, wheel, key, text, click, or reset event.

Common options:
  --project PATH       Project file or directory.
  --pid PID            Select one process ID.
  --pipe NAME          Select one pipe or socket endpoint.
  --app NAME           Select by application name.
  --window NAME        Select by window title.
  --latest             Select the newest endpoint.
  --wait SECONDS       Wait for a descriptor, up to 300 seconds.
  --inspector          Launch the standalone inspector when ready.
  --focus              Launch or focus the standalone inspector.
  --json               Keep protocol output as JSON lines.

Environment:
  GOO_DEVTOOLS_DIR         Runtime descriptor directory override.
  GOO_DEVTOOLS_INSPECTOR   Standalone inspector executable or DLL.
  GOO_DEVTOOLS_INPUT=1     Permit application input when GOO_DEVTOOLS=1 enables diagnostics.
